name: Sliced Volume Rendering
aliases: Sliced Volume Rendering with Transfer Functions and Lighting
definition: A technique to render volumetric data by generating slice geometry on the fly using the vl::SlicedVolume class, supporting real-time lighting (up to 4 lights) and transfer functions via GLSL, or precomputed illumination.
summary: Sliced Volume Rendering dynamically generates slice geometry to render volumetric data with real-time lighting and transfer functions, differing by tightly coupling geometry generation with specific rendering pipelines.
